artists.biography: Durand Jones & The Indications is an American contemporary R&B and soul group founded by the core songwriting trio of singer Durand Jones, singer/drummer Aaron Frazer, and guitarist Blake Rhein. Formed in 2012, the band came to prominence as part of the soul revivalist movement around the time of the reissue of their debut album in 2018. Their second album American Love Call was released in March 2019, followed by Private Space in July 2021.

Durand Jones & The Indications.biography: Durand Jones & The Indications is an American contemporary R&B and soul group founded by the core songwriting trio of singer Durand Jones, singer/drummer Aaron Frazer, and guitarist Blake Rhein. Formed in 2012, the band came to prominence as part of the soul revivalist movement around the time of the reissue of their debut album in 2018. Their second album American Love Call was released in March 2019, followed by Private Space in July 2021.

perplexity.description:
Private Space is the third studio album by Durand Jones & The Indications, released on July 30, 2021, via Dead Oceans in association with Colemine Records. Marking a creative evolution for the group, the album expands beyond the classic soul and funk foundations of their earlier work, embracing a more modern, synth-driven sound infused with disco rhythms, lush strings, and atmospheric arrangements. Recorded in New York City, the ten-track record showcases a collaborative effort from the band’s core trio—Durand Jones, Aaron Frazer, and Blake Rhein—alongside contributions from arrangers, session musicians, and guest artists, resulting in an organic yet adventurous blend of vintage and contemporary soul.

In the context of their discography, Private Space represents a bold departure from the retro-soul revivalism of their debut and the more traditional R&B of American Love Call (2019). The album’s themes of escapism, resilience, and emotional connection resonated with listeners in the wake of a tumultuous year, earning praise for its innovative production and timeless songwriting. Critics highlighted its seamless fusion of disco, modern soul, and classic funk, noting the band’s ability to balance experimentation with accessibility. The album was well-received commercially and critically, solidifying Durand Jones & The Indications’ reputation as leading figures in the contemporary soul scene.
